notes.title: Major Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Big ghoulish update with a [b]brand new game mode and a Halloween-inspired level — Maze Runner![i] (also available in the demo!!)[/i][/b]There are also exploding pumpkins, new power-ups, plus a lot of quality of life/UI improvements. 

AND to celebrate this most horrific of holidays, [b]we're also launching a big competition [/b]around the new level.  Be the first one to beat it, or have a top-10 finish — and[b] you can win some really killer stuff[/b], from [b]Funko POP!s [/b]to [b]Game Bundles (worth up to $75)[/b] plus[b] a lot more[/b]!  [b]Competition starts at 9am PST on October 28![/b]

[list]
[*] New game mode: Maze Runner
[*] New map/level: The Great Halloween Maze Escape
[*] New leaderboards
[*] Exploding pumpkins
[*] Power-ups: Insta-heal and Insta-drunk
[*] Boss Zombies with seasonal head-attire
[*] Tons of bugs fixed and UI improvements.
[/list]

Check www.whiskeyandzombies.com for more info, rules, and schedule for the competition.  
(We are also just giving away a bunch of stuff on social media, if you're into free stuff :))

Happy Halloween!!
/Team McCreary

notes.title: August Update
notes.notes:
We have gone in a tinkered under-the-hood and hopefully the leaderboards are now fully operational. 
 (Thanks for everyone that pointed this out).  Erroneous entries on the boards will be amended.  If you are adversely effected and you feel this is where I'm gonna plant my flag -- drop us a line at support@whiskeyandzombies.com and we will make it up to you!

Happy drunk gaming the apocalypse! :)
/Team McCreary

notes.title: Whiskey & Zombies Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34835490/fcfa99725dc1df0f555c71881c77b8b8bac238d2.png[/img]

Big ‘ol update with [b]tons of fixes[/b] under the hood and a [b]totally revamped and expanded leaderboard[/b].  It is also platform-independent now — which means that players on upcoming systems will compete with everyone else.  Don’t worry, there’s no crappy aim assist in this game, everyone has the same shitty drunken aim as everyone else... x.O.  All current stats on the Steam leaderboards will hopefully transfer over nicely.

We have also fixed some of the broken achievements here on Steam and [b]we have added some new achievements —[/b] some are public but we have added [b]three hidden ones that come with a prize![/b]  First to unlock all three before October 31st 2021 gets something really nifty!  Just drop us a line and show us a screencap of your achievements!  

It took a little time to get this one out as we updated to a newer version of Unity, something very NOT advisable during production but we had to do it.  Now, we have some more options moving forward for things we’ve wanted to implement for a while.  Now, we just need to put down the celebratory bottle(s) long enough to get ‘em done!

Drink. Fight. Stay Alive.
/Team McCreary


[LEADERBOARDS]
- New platform-independent system 
- Tons of new leaderboards

[ACHIEVEMENTS & STATS]
- Fixed broken achievements by fixing stats not calculating correctly
- New stats and achievements added
- New hidden achievements added

[MISC]
- General optimizations
- Bug Fixes

notes.title: Whiskey & Zombies Major Update
notes.notes:
We are super stoked to be able to announce Whiskey & Zombies v1.5. This is a major update with not one but two big new features. We are finally bringing [b]a new game mode[/b] — Last Hillbilly Standing and [b]a whole new map[/b] — The Pits! Here you can settle old scores in some Player vs Player vs Zombies fast-paced action.

The other fun feature is leaderboards! No more arguing over who is the best undead redneck slaying machine.  This is available in the demo as well.

And based on your feedback, we have made tons of smaller improvements such as Brighter Levels (so you can see the zombies a little easier) and Enhanced Zombie NPC behavior. There are also tons of optimizations, bug fixes, and quality of life improvements.  

We super hope you enjoy this update. Be sure to let us know what you think!  

[NEW GAME MODE]
- Multiplayer game mode Last Hillbilly Standing added
- New Last Hillbilly Standing map added — The Pit

[LEADERBOARDS]
- First batch of steam leaderboards
- Seperate leaderboards for demo

[MISC]
- Brightness increased in all levels
- Enhanced npc/zombie behaviour
- General optimizations
- Bug Fixes

notes.title: Whiskey & Zombies Update News
notes.notes:
So we finally got around to releasing [b]Whiskey & Zombies[/b]! Thanks for the amazing response so far, brings joy to our shitkicker hearts. And we super appreciate all the feedback — keep it coming, the good, the bad, and the ugly! We are trying to make this the funniest (and hardest most frustratingly exciting) game possible so any and all input is amazing.

We have been making a bunch of small updates over the last weeks to improve the game, and we will continue to do so. We fixed a lot of smaller bugs, multiplayer balancing issues, and quality of life improvements. The biggest thing was that we opened up most of the levels from the start, not just the first. (we keep forgetting that we are old school gamers who are used to the progression aspect…) So enjoy the different kinds of zombie mayhem!

That’s it for now. A lot more fun stuff is just around the corner… or so Zombie Santa tells us ;)

Cheers!
Erik McCreary
